app.name: Oneko SDL WiiU
app.short_description: Neko - cat follows touch or mouse events
app.long_description:
Oneko ported to SDL by hito16. Acknowledgments: thanks to DanielKO for help compiling for WiiU, especially fixes to SDL and makefiles.
Wikipedia: "Neko was originally written for the NEC PC-9801. It was later ported as a desk accessory to the Macintosh in 1989 by Kenji Gotoh. He also designed the sleeping graphics for Neko. An X version was later made by Masayuki Koba."
From oneko port: https://github.com/tie/oneko Original program "xneko" written by Masayuki Koba, Modified to program "oneko" by Tatsuya Kato, Modified furthermore by, John Lerchey, Eric Anderson, Toshihiro Kanda, Kiichiroh Mukose
